about_short_description.short_description: TeamViewer is an all-in-one solution for remote access, support, collaboration, and desktop sharing over the Internet.

product.name: TeamViewer ONE
product.description: An integrated platform for remote access, IT support, endpoint management, digital experience monitoring, and AI-assisted IT automation.

product.name: TeamViewer Remote
product.description: A remote access and support solution for connecting to computers and devices, troubleshooting problems, and providing IT assistance over the Internet.

product.name: TeamViewer DEX
product.description: A digital employee experience platform that monitors endpoint health, provides IT insights, and automates remediation before issues disrupt users.

product.name: TeamViewer Frontline
product.description: An augmented reality workflow platform for logistics, manufacturing, training, and field operations using smart glasses and hands-free guidance.

product.name: TeamViewer AI
product.description: AI capabilities for automating IT support, summarizing support sessions, identifying recurring issues, and generating remediation workflows.

product.name: TeamViewer Tensor
product.description: An enterprise remote connectivity and support solution designed for secure, scalable management of remote access across large organizations.
